Maria (Marketing): Hey team — prepping webinar slides for the Apr launch. We need a quick sanity rerun of the benchmark numbers used in our "Latency vs Cost" slide. Can eng/runtime run a narrow rerun with the traffic shape in the attached payloads and return per-model p50/p95, tokens/sec, and error rates? Target: EOD tomorrow.
Ben (Marketing): +1 — specifically need numbers for open-35-ish models and our quantized variants. Also need a 2–3 sentence methodology blurb we can paste in the deck.
Sam (Eng Runtime): @Maria can you paste the exact payloads and the sequence length distribution? Also which infra to run on (Dedicated vs hosted baseline)?
Maria (Marketing): Posting sample payloads below. Use seq_len distribution: 1000 requests total — 50% short (<=64), 30% medium (65-256), 20% long (257-1024). Include streaming off and one run with streaming on. Payload snippet:
```
{"prompt": "Summarize the following release notes...", "max_tokens": 256}
```
Sam (Eng Runtime): Got it. We'll run on Dedicated (p4d-equivalent) and hosted baseline. Plan: 3 trials per model, capture p50/p95/mean, tokens/sec, and 5xx rates. Which exact model names?
Leah (Eng Runtime): We'll also capture memory spikes and tail-latency logs; will post a tiny sample log if we see OOM patterns.
Maria (Marketing): Confirming models: open-35, open-35-int8, rw_inference-v2. Freeze configs: batch_size=64, max_batch_latency_ms=20. Please note any deviations.
Ben (Marketing): For the narrative, we want a clear line: "numbers reflect typical PLG web traffic; heavy tails represented by 20% long requests." Keep methodology bullets short and copy-ready.
Sam (Eng Runtime): We can do that. ETA: start tomorrow morning, finish by EOD. Two clarifying asks: (1) what are the acceptance criteria for 'sanity' (e.g., p95 within X%?), and (2) any special telemetry/CSV columns you want?
Maria (Marketing): Acceptance: p50 within 10% and p95 within 20% of previously published numbers; no increase in 5xx rate greater than 0.1%. Telemetry columns we want: model, infra, trial_id, p50_ms, p95_ms, mean_ms, tokens_per_sec, 5xx_count, cpu_pct_avg, gpu_mem_mb_peak, notes.
CI Bot: rerun-scheduler: job queued (id: bch-2026-04-15-07)
Sam (Eng Runtime): Note: quantized variant uses a different kernel path — might show higher throughput but slightly worse tail latency. We'll flag this in notes. We'll also include kernel version and CUDA/cuDNN info in the CSV.
Leah (Eng Runtime): If we hit OOM or >0.5% 5xx in any trial we'll abort and capture core dump + minimal repro; we'll attach logs and a short explanation.
Maria (Marketing): Awesome — thanks. After you finish, please drop the CSV + a 3-line summary in #marketing and tag @Ben. :pray:
Ben (Marketing): I'll draft slide copy from the 3-line summary. If there are any gotchas call them out plainly (e.g., quantization tradeoffs).
Sam (Eng Runtime): Copy. Will post an interim note when the first trial completes and then the final CSV.
Leah (Eng Runtime): Also adding a tiny methodology.md to the artifacts: command lines, seeds, and traffic generator config.
Maria (Marketing): Perfect — that should cover everything. If timeline slips, ping @Ben and we'll adjust slide ordering. :calendar:
